def: The mini-FML search study: an AIDE-style tree-search agent compared with greedy hill-climbing on three FML-Bench tasks.
The evaluator-hardening kit: break a KernelBench grader, harden it, and measure the hacking rate before and after.
The fraction of accepted candidates that score well on the visible tests but much worse on the hidden ones.
The software around a model that runs its loop: its tools, context, files and checks on results.
The code that produces a score, which must sit outside the proposer's reach if the score is to mean anything.
